hero.title: How does your website
hero.subtitle: An instant scan of your website's accessibility, SEO, content quality, and performance. See what's holding you back, in plain language.
hero.subnote: Takes about 15 seconds. We scan your homepage and show you the results instantly.

features.heading: What you'll discover
features.subheading: We check the things that matter most for your business's online presence.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Can every visitor use your site? We check screen reader support, color contrast, keyboard navigation, and more.

content.title: Content Quality
content.description: Is your message clear? We analyze readability, heading structure, and whether your calls-to-action actually work.

seo.title: SEO Basics
seo.description: Can Google find you? We check meta tags, heading hierarchy, image descriptions, and other ranking factors.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Is your site fast enough? Slow pages lose visitors. We measure load time and flag what to fix.

step1.title: Enter your URL
step1.description: Paste your website address. No account, no strings attached.

step2.title: Get your score
step2.description: In about 15 seconds, see your overall score and top issues in plain language.

step3.title: Get the full report
step3.description: Enter your email to receive a detailed report with page-by-page analysis and fix recommendations.

bottomCta.heading: Ready to see how your site stacks up?
bottomCta.subheading: Free, takes 15 seconds, and likely surfaces issues you've never noticed.

scanResults.title: Scan Results
scanResults.adashiContext: Adashi builds performance and automation systems for growing businesses. This audit names the issues that cost you visitors, conversions, and credibility, and shows what to fix first.

scanFailedNotice.heading: We couldn't fully scan this website
scanFailedNotice.body: Our scanner couldn't load {domain}. This usually happens with very heavy sites, sites that block automated tools, or pages that require a login. The scores below reflect what we could measure before the error.

revenueImpact.label: Revenue impact
revenueImpact.intro: Google research shows <highlight>53% of mobile users leave pages that take longer than 3 seconds to load</highlight>, and each extra second cuts conversions by up to 7% (Akamai). The factors below are based on what we found in your scan.
revenueImpact.footnote: Impact estimates are based on the specific issues found in your scan, informed by Google and Akamai research.
